pt.title: [Logística 101 #1] O Trabalho de Trilhões de Dólares Que Ninguém Vê: O Que Realmente É Logística

segments.src: > Logistics is the work of getting the right thing to the right place at the right time and cost — and in the U.S. it's roughly a $2.5 trillion-a-year industry that most people only notice when it fails.
segments.tr: > Logística é o trabalho de colocar a coisa certa no lugar certo no momento certo e ao custo certo — e nos EUA é aproximadamente uma indústria de $2,5 trilhões por ano que a maioria das pessoas só percebe quando falha.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Ask someone what logistics is and you'll usually hear "trucks."
segments.tr: Pergunte a alguém o que é logística e você geralmente ouvirá "caminhões".

segments.src: That's like saying finance is "ATMs."
segments.tr: É como dizer que finanças é "caixas eletrônicos".

segments.src: The trade association CSCMP defines logistics management as the part of supply chain management that plans, implements, and controls the efficient flow and storage of goods, services, and related information — from the point of origin to the point of consumption, and back again.
segments.tr: A associação comercial CSCMP define gerenciamento de logística como a parte do gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos que planeja, implementa e controla o fluxo eficiente e armazenamento de bens, serviços e informações relacionadas — do ponto de origem até o ponto de consumo, e volta.

segments.src: Strip out the jargon and you get four verbs: **move, store, handle, inform.**
segments.tr: Remova o jargão e você obtém quatro verbos: **mover, armazenar, manusear, informar.**

segments.src: Practitioners often summarize the goal as the **seven rights**: the right product, in the right quantity, in the right condition, at the right place, at the right time, to the right customer, at the right cost.
segments.tr: Profissionais frequentemente resumem o objetivo como os **sete direitos**: o produto certo, na quantidade certa, nas condições corretas, no lugar certo, no momento certo, para o cliente certo, ao custo certo.

segments.src: Notice that six of the seven are about *service* and only one is about *price*.
segments.tr: Observe que seis dos sete são sobre *serviço* e apenas um é sobre *preço*.

segments.src: That tension is the entire discipline.
segments.tr: Essa tensão é toda a disciplina.

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: logistics doesn't change what a product *is*.
segments.tr: Aqui está a parte que surpreende as pessoas: a logística não muda o que um produto *é*.

segments.src: A pair of running shoes sitting in a warehouse in Ohio is chemically identical to the same pair on your doorstep in Denver.
segments.tr: Um par de tênis de corrida em um armazém em Ohio é quimicamente idêntico ao mesmo par na sua porta em Denver.

segments.src: What logistics creates is **place utility** (value from being where you need it) and **time utility** (value from being there when you need it).
segments.tr: O que a logística cria é **utilidade de lugar** (valor por estar onde você precisa) e **utilidade de tempo** (valor por estar lá quando você precisa).

segments.src: An umbrella in a warehouse is inventory.
segments.tr: Um guarda-chuva em um armazém é inventário.

segments.src: An umbrella in a store lobby during a downpour is a sale.
segments.tr: Um guarda-chuva no lobby de uma loja durante uma tempestade é uma venda.

segments.src: **So how is this different from supply chain management?** Think of nested boxes.
segments.tr: **Então, como isso é diferente do gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos?** Pense em caixas aninhadas.

segments.src: Supply chain management (SCM) is the bigger box — it covers sourcing raw materials, negotiating with suppliers, planning production, forecasting demand, and coordinating everyone from the cotton farmer to the cashier.
segments.tr: Gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos (SCM) é a caixa maior — ela cobre fornecimento de matérias-primas, negociação com fornecedores, planejamento de produção, previsão de demanda e coordenação de todos, desde o fazendeiro de algodão até o caixa.

segments.src: Logistics is the box inside it that handles physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: Logística é a caixa dentro dela que lida com fluxo físico e armazenamento.

segments.src: A useful shorthand:
segments.tr: Uma taquigrafia útil:

segments.src: - **SCM asks:** who should make this, where, in what quantity, and on what terms?
segments.tr: - **SCM pergunta:** quem deve fazer isso, onde, em qual quantidade e sob quais condições?

segments.src: - **Logistics asks:** given those decisions, how does it physically get there, how fast, and at what cost?
segments.tr: - **Logística pergunta:** dadas essas decisões, como ela chega lá fisicamente, com que rapidez e a que custo?

segments.src: You can't do good SCM without logistics, but logistics alone won't save you from a bad sourcing decision.
segments.tr: Você não pode fazer um bom SCM sem logística, mas a logística sozinha não o salvará de uma decisão de fornecimento ruim.

segments.src: If your supplier is 8,000 miles away and your product has a six-week shelf life, no amount of clever routing fixes that.
segments.tr: Se seu fornecedor está a 8.000 milhas de distância e seu produto tem uma vida útil de seis semanas, nenhuma quantidade de roteamento inteligente corrige isso.

segments.src: The other thing to know upfront: logistics is a **trade-off machine**, not an optimization with one answer.
segments.tr: A outra coisa a saber de antemão: logística é uma **máquina de compensações**, não uma otimização com uma resposta.

segments.src: Air freight is fast and expensive; ocean is cheap and slow.
segments.tr: Frete aéreo é rápido e caro; oceano é barato e lento.

segments.src: Holding lots of inventory means you never stock out, but the industry rule of thumb is that carrying inventory costs roughly 20–25% of its value per year in capital, warehousing, insurance, and obsolescence.
segments.tr: Manter muito inventário significa que você nunca fica sem estoque, mas a regra prática da indústria é que o custo de manutenção de inventário é aproximadamente 20–25% do seu valor por ano em capital, armazenamento, seguro e obsolescência.

segments.src: Five regional warehouses shorten delivery times but multiply fixed costs.
segments.tr: Cinco armazéns regionais encurtam os tempos de entrega, mas multiplicam os custos fixos.

segments.src: Every logistics decision is somebody choosing a point on a curve — usually the curve between **cost and speed**, or between **cost and reliability**.
segments.tr: Cada decisão de logística é alguém escolhendo um ponto em uma curva — geralmente a curva entre **custo e velocidade**, ou entre **custo e confiabilidade**.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: You order running shoes for $89 on a Sunday night from your couch in Denver.
segments.tr: Você encomenda tênis de corrida por $89 em uma noite de domingo do seu sofá em Denver.

segments.src: Free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: Frete grátis em dois dias.

segments.src: Here's the invisible machine that runs before Tuesday.
segments.tr: Aqui está a máquina invisível que funciona antes de terça-feira.

segments.src: The moment you click, an inventory system decides *which* of several U.S.
segments.tr: No momento em que você clica, um sistema de inventário decide *qual* de vários U.S.

segments.src: fulfillment centers should ship — not necessarily the closest one, but the one that balances distance, stock levels, and how many other Denver-bound orders it can consolidate into the same truck.
segments.tr: centros de atendimento devem enviar — não necessariamente o mais próximo, mas aquele que equilibra distância, níveis de estoque e quantas outras encomendas com destino a Denver ele pode consolidar no mesmo caminhão.

segments.src: A worker (or increasingly, a robotic shelf-mover) picks your box, and it gets sorted onto a line-haul truck.
segments.tr: Um trabalhador (ou cada vez mais, um robô que move prateleiras) pega sua caixa e ela é carregada em um caminhão de longa distância.

segments.src: That truck may run to a sorting hub — the two most famous in the country are UPS's Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky, and FedEx's superhub in Memphis, Tennessee, both of which exist because they sit near the population-weighted center of the U.S.
segments.tr: Esse caminhão pode ir para um centro de classificação — os dois mais famosos do país são o Worldport da UPS em Louisville, Kentucky, e o superhub da FedEx em Memphis, Tennessee, ambos existem porque ficam perto do centro ponderado pela população dos EUA.

segments.src: and let packages from everywhere meet, re-sort overnight, and fly back out before dawn.
segments.tr: e deixam pacotes de todos os lugares se encontrarem, serem reclassificados durante a noite e voarem de volta antes do amanhecer.

segments.src: From there your box moves to a local delivery station, gets loaded onto a van with 150 other stops, and a route algorithm decides the driver's sequence.
segments.tr: De lá sua caixa se move para uma estação de entrega local, é carregada em uma van com 150 outras paradas, e um algoritmo de rota decide a sequência do motorista.

segments.src: That final leg — the delivery station to your door — is called the **last mile**, and it's routinely the single most expensive segment of the whole journey.
segments.tr: Esse trecho final — da estação de entrega até sua porta — é chamado de **última milha**, e é rotineiramente o segmento mais caro de toda a jornada.

segments.src: One truck crossing Nebraska carries thousands of packages at once; one van in a Denver neighborhood carries a few hundred and burns an hour in traffic.
segments.tr: Um caminhão atravessando Nebraska carrega milhares de pacotes de uma vez; uma van em um bairro de Denver carrega algumas centenas e gasta uma hora no trânsito.

segments.src: Trucking is the largest single line item in U.S.
segments.tr: Transporte por caminhão é o maior item de linha único em U.S.

segments.src: logistics spending, and last-mile delivery is why.
segments.tr: gastos de logística, e a entrega da última milha é por quê.

segments.src: "Free shipping" is, of course, not free.
segments.tr: "Frete grátis" não é, é claro, grátis.

segments.src: It's priced into the $89, subsidized by your membership fee, or absorbed as a customer-acquisition cost.
segments.tr: É precificado nos $89, subsidiado pela sua taxa de associação, ou absorvido como um custo de aquisição de cliente.

segments.src: Somebody paid for the van.
segments.tr: Alguém pagou pela van.

segments.src: Now zoom out.
segments.tr: Agora amplie a perspectiva.

segments.src: Recent CSCMP *State of Logistics* reports put total U.S.
segments.tr: Relatórios recentes da CSCMP *State of Logistics* colocam o total de U.S.

segments.src: business logistics costs at roughly **$2.5 trillion, or about 8–9% of GDP**.
segments.tr: custos de logística comercial em aproximadamente **$2.5 trilhões, ou cerca de 8–9% do PIB**.

segments.src: That's the scale of the industry that made your Tuesday delivery unremarkable.
segments.tr: É a escala da indústria que tornou sua entrega de terça-feira comum.

segments.src: And it's changing fast.
segments.tr: E está mudando rapidamente.

segments.src: Four trends worth knowing:
segments.tr: Quatro tendências que valem a pena conhecer:

segments.src: 1. **E-commerce reshaped the network.** Retail logistics used to mean moving pallets to a few hundred stores. Now it means moving single boxes to millions of homes — a completely different cost structure, which is why warehouse space near cities got so valuable.
segments.tr: 1. **E-commerce reformulou a rede.** A logística de varejo costumava significar mover paletes para algumas centenas de lojas. Agora significa mover caixas individuais para milhões de casas — uma estrutura de custo completamente diferente, razão pela qual o espaço de armazém perto das cidades ficou tão valioso.

segments.src: 2. **Automation is filling warehouses**, driven by both labor shortages and volume — robotic picking, automated sortation, and warehouse management software.
segments.tr: 2. **Automação está preenchendo armazéns**, impulsionada tanto pela escassez de mão de obra quanto pelo volume — coleta robótica, classificação automatizada e software de gerenciamento de armazém.

segments.src: 3. **Resilience is now a board-level word.** The 2020–2022 disruptions — port congestion, the Suez blockage, chip shortages — taught companies that the cheapest supply chain and the most reliable one are rarely the same. Hence "nearshoring," dual sourcing, and holding a bit more safety stock than pure efficiency would suggest.
segments.tr: 3. **Resiliência é agora uma palavra ao nível do conselho.** As perturbações de 2020–2022 — congestionamento portuário, o bloqueio de Suez, escassez de chips — ensinaram às empresas que a cadeia de suprimentos mais barata e a mais confiável raramente são as mesmas. Daí "nearshoring", dual sourcing, e manter um pouco mais de estoque de segurança do que a eficiência pura sugeriria.

segments.src: 4. **Visibility is the new battleground.** Knowing exactly where a shipment is, and predicting when it will actually arrive, is often worth more than shaving a few cents off the freight rate.
segments.tr: 4. **Visibilidade é o novo campo de batalha.** Saber exatamente onde está um carregamento e prever quando realmente chegará, muitas vezes vale mais do que cortar alguns centavos da taxa de frete.

segments.src: A last practical concept: when comparing two suppliers, the sticker price is the wrong number.
segments.tr: Um último conceito prático: ao comparar dois fornecedores, o preço de etiqueta é o número errado.

segments.src: What matters is **landed cost**:
segments.tr: O que importa é **custo de desembarque**:

segments.src: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling
segments.tr: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling

segments.src: A part that's 15% cheaper from overseas can easily be more expensive once it lands.
segments.tr: Uma peça que é 15% mais barata do exterior pode facilmente ser mais cara uma vez que chega.

segments.src: That single line is why logistics belongs in strategy meetings and not just in the loading dock.
segments.tr: Essa única linha é o motivo pelo qual a logística pertence às reuniões de estratégia e não apenas à doca de carregamento.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3줄 정리

segments.src: 1. Logistics is the move-store-handle-inform work that creates **place and time utility** — it doesn't change the product, it changes where and when it's available.
segments.tr: 1. Logística é o trabalho de mover-armazenar-manusear-informar que cria **utilidade de lugar e tempo** — não muda o produto, muda onde e quando está disponível.

segments.src: 2. Logistics is a **subset of supply chain management**: SCM decides who makes what, where, and how much; logistics executes the physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: 2. Logística é um **subconjunto do gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos**: SCM decide quem faz o quê, onde e quanto; a logística executa o fluxo físico e armazenamento.

segments.src: 3. Every logistics decision is a **trade-off** among cost, speed, and reliability — and the honest number to compare is landed cost, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 3. Cada decisão de logística é uma **compensação** entre custo, velocidade e confiabilidade — e o número honesto para comparar é custo de desembarque, não preço de etiqueta.

segments.tr: Ketegangan itu adalah seluruh disiplin ilmu.

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: logistics doesn't change what a product *is*.
segments.tr: Berikut adalah bagian yang mengejutkan orang: logistik tidak mengubah apa produk *itu*.

segments.src: A pair of running shoes sitting in a warehouse in Ohio is chemically identical to the same pair on your doorstep in Denver.
segments.tr: Sepasang sepatu lari yang ada di gudang di Ohio secara kimia identik dengan pasangan yang sama di depan pintu Anda di Denver.

segments.src: What logistics creates is **place utility** (value from being where you need it) and **time utility** (value from being there when you need it).
segments.tr: Apa yang logistik ciptakan adalah **utilitas tempat** (nilai dari berada di mana Anda membutuhkannya) dan **utilitas waktu** (nilai dari berada di sana ketika Anda membutuhkannya).

segments.src: An umbrella in a warehouse is inventory.
segments.tr: Payung di gudang adalah inventaris.

segments.src: An umbrella in a store lobby during a downpour is a sale.
segments.tr: Payung di lobi toko selama hujan deras adalah penjualan.

segments.src: **So how is this different from supply chain management?** Think of nested boxes.
segments.tr: **Jadi, bagaimana ini berbeda dari manajemen rantai pasokan?** Pikirkan kotak bersarang.

segments.src: Supply chain management (SCM) is the bigger box — it covers sourcing raw materials, negotiating with suppliers, planning production, forecasting demand, and coordinating everyone from the cotton farmer to the cashier.
segments.tr: Manajemen rantai pasokan (SCM) adalah kotak yang lebih besar — ini mencakup pengadaan bahan baku, negosiasi dengan pemasok, perencanaan produksi, peramalan permintaan, dan koordinasi semua orang dari petani kapas ke kasir.

segments.src: Logistics is the box inside it that handles physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: Logistik adalah kotak di dalamnya yang menangani aliran dan penyimpanan fisik.

segments.src: A useful shorthand:
segments.tr: Singkatan yang berguna:

segments.src: - **SCM asks:** who should make this, where, in what quantity, and on what terms?
segments.tr: - **SCM menanyakan:** siapa yang harus membuat ini, di mana, dalam jumlah berapa, dan dengan syarat apa?

segments.src: - **Logistics asks:** given those decisions, how does it physically get there, how fast, and at what cost?
segments.tr: - **Logistik menanyakan:** mengingat keputusan tersebut, bagaimana cara fisiknya sampai ke sana, seberapa cepat, dan dengan biaya berapa?

segments.src: You can't do good SCM without logistics, but logistics alone won't save you from a bad sourcing decision.
segments.tr: Anda tidak dapat melakukan SCM yang baik tanpa logistik, tetapi logistik saja tidak akan menyelamatkan Anda dari keputusan pengadaan yang buruk.

segments.src: If your supplier is 8,000 miles away and your product has a six-week shelf life, no amount of clever routing fixes that.
segments.tr: Jika pemasok Anda 8.000 mil jauhnya dan produk Anda memiliki umur simpan enam minggu, tidak ada jumlah perutean cerdas yang memperbaikinya.

segments.src: The other thing to know upfront: logistics is a **trade-off machine**, not an optimization with one answer.
segments.tr: Hal lain yang perlu diketahui: logistik adalah **mesin trade-off**, bukan optimasi dengan satu jawaban.

segments.src: Air freight is fast and expensive; ocean is cheap and slow.
segments.tr: Pengiriman udara cepat dan mahal; laut murah dan lambat.

segments.src: Holding lots of inventory means you never stock out, but the industry rule of thumb is that carrying inventory costs roughly 20–25% of its value per year in capital, warehousing, insurance, and obsolescence.
segments.tr: Menyimpan banyak inventaris berarti Anda tidak akan pernah kehabisan stok, tetapi aturan praktis industri adalah bahwa biaya membawa inventaris kira-kira 20–25% nilainya per tahun dalam modal, pergudangan, asuransi, dan keusangan.

segments.src: Five regional warehouses shorten delivery times but multiply fixed costs.
segments.tr: Lima gudang regional mempersingkat waktu pengiriman tetapi mengalikan biaya tetap.

segments.src: Every logistics decision is somebody choosing a point on a curve — usually the curve between **cost and speed**, or between **cost and reliability**.
segments.tr: Setiap keputusan logistik adalah seseorang memilih titik pada kurva — biasanya kurva antara **biaya dan kecepatan**, atau antara **biaya dan keandalan**.

segments.src: That's the scale of the industry that made your Tuesday delivery unremarkable.
segments.tr: Itulah skala industri yang membuat pengiriman Selasa Anda biasa saja.

segments.src: And it's changing fast.
segments.tr: Dan itu berubah dengan cepat.

segments.src: Four trends worth knowing:
segments.tr: Empat tren yang perlu diketahui:

segments.src: 1. **E-commerce reshaped the network.** Retail logistics used to mean moving pallets to a few hundred stores. Now it means moving single boxes to millions of homes — a completely different cost structure, which is why warehouse space near cities got so valuable.
segments.tr: 1. **E-commerce membentuk ulang jaringan.** Logistik ritel biasanya berarti memindahkan palet ke beberapa ratus toko. Sekarang itu berarti memindahkan kotak tunggal ke jutaan rumah — struktur biaya yang sama sekali berbeda, itulah mengapa ruang gudang di dekat kota menjadi sangat berharga.

segments.src: 2. **Automation is filling warehouses**, driven by both labor shortages and volume — robotic picking, automated sortation, and warehouse management software.
segments.tr: 2. **Otomasi mengisi gudang**, didorong oleh kekurangan tenaga kerja dan volume — pengambilan robotik, sortasi otomatis, dan perangkat lunak manajemen gudang.

segments.src: 3. **Resilience is now a board-level word.** The 2020–2022 disruptions — port congestion, the Suez blockage, chip shortages — taught companies that the cheapest supply chain and the most reliable one are rarely the same. Hence "nearshoring," dual sourcing, and holding a bit more safety stock than pure efficiency would suggest.
segments.tr: 3. **Ketahanan sekarang adalah kata tingkat dewan.** Gangguan 2020–2022 — kemacetan pelabuhan, blokade Suez, kekurangan chip — mengajarkan perusahaan bahwa rantai pasokan termurah dan yang paling andal jarang sama. Oleh karena itu "nearshoring," dual sourcing, dan menyimpan stok keselamatan sedikit lebih banyak daripada yang akan disarankan oleh efisiensi murni.

segments.src: 4. **Visibility is the new battleground.** Knowing exactly where a shipment is, and predicting when it will actually arrive, is often worth more than shaving a few cents off the freight rate.
segments.tr: 4. **Visibilitas adalah medan pertempuran baru.** Mengetahui persis di mana pengiriman itu, dan memprediksi kapan itu akan tiba, sering kali lebih berharga daripada mengurangi beberapa sen dari tarif pengiriman.

segments.src: A last practical concept: when comparing two suppliers, the sticker price is the wrong number.
segments.tr: Konsep praktis terakhir: saat membandingkan dua pemasok, harga label adalah angka yang salah.

segments.src: What matters is **landed cost**:
segments.tr: Yang penting adalah **biaya tiba**:

segments.src: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling
segments.tr: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling

segments.src: A part that's 15% cheaper from overseas can easily be more expensive once it lands.
segments.tr: Suku cadang yang 15% lebih murah dari luar negeri dapat dengan mudah menjadi lebih mahal setelah tiba.

segments.src: That single line is why logistics belongs in strategy meetings and not just in the loading dock.
segments.tr: Baris tunggal itu adalah mengapa logistik memiliki tempat di pertemuan strategi dan bukan hanya di loading dock.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris

segments.src: 1. Logistics is the move-store-handle-inform work that creates **place and time utility** — it doesn't change the product, it changes where and when it's available.
segments.tr: 1. Logistik adalah pekerjaan pindah-simpan-tangani-informasikan yang menciptakan **utilitas tempat dan waktu** — itu tidak mengubah produk, itu mengubah di mana dan kapan produk tersedia.

segments.src: 2. Logistics is a **subset of supply chain management**: SCM decides who makes what, where, and how much; logistics executes the physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: 2. Logistik adalah **bagian dari manajemen rantai pasokan**: SCM memutuskan siapa membuat apa, di mana, dan berapa banyak; logistik mengeksekusi aliran dan penyimpanan fisik.

segments.src: 3. Every logistics decision is a **trade-off** among cost, speed, and reliability — and the honest number to compare is landed cost, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 3. Setiap keputusan logistik adalah **trade-off** antara biaya, kecepatan, dan keandalan — dan angka jujur untuk dibandingkan adalah biaya tiba, bukan harga label.

segments.src: Five regional warehouses shorten delivery times but multiply fixed costs.
segments.tr: 5つの地域倉庫は配送時間を短縮しますが、固定費を増やします。

segments.src: Every logistics decision is somebody choosing a point on a curve — usually the curve between **cost and speed**, or between **cost and reliability**.
segments.tr: すべてのロジスティクス決定は、誰かが曲線上のポイントを選択することです。通常は**コストと速度**の間、または**コストと信頼性**の間の曲線です。

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 日常の中で

segments.src: You order running shoes for $89 on a Sunday night from your couch in Denver.
segments.tr: 日曜日の夜、デンバーのソファーから89ドルのランニングシューズを注文します。

segments.src: Free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: 送料無料の2日配送。

segments.src: Here's the invisible machine that runs before Tuesday.
segments.tr: 火曜日前に走る見えない機械です。

segments.src: The moment you click, an inventory system decides *which* of several U.S.
segments.tr: クリックした瞬間に、在庫システムは米国内のいくつかのうちの*どれ*かを決定します。

segments.src: fulfillment centers should ship — not necessarily the closest one, but the one that balances distance, stock levels, and how many other Denver-bound orders it can consolidate into the same truck.
segments.tr: フルフィルメントセンターが発送すべきものは、必ずしも最も近いものではなく、距離、在庫レベル、および同じトラックに統合できるその他のデンバー行きの注文の数のバランスを取るものです。

segments.src: A worker (or increasingly, a robotic shelf-mover) picks your box, and it gets sorted onto a line-haul truck.
segments.tr: ワーカー（またはますますロボット棚移動機）があなたのボックスを選び、ラインハウルトラックにソートされます。

segments.src: That truck may run to a sorting hub — the two most famous in the country are UPS's Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky, and FedEx's superhub in Memphis, Tennessee, both of which exist because they sit near the population-weighted center of the U.S.
segments.tr: そのトラックはソーティングハブまで走る可能性があります。国内で最も有名な2つは、ケンタッキー州ルイビルのUPSのWorldportとテネシー州メンフィスのFedExのスーパーハブで、両方とも米国の人口加重中心地近くに位置しているため存在します。

segments.src: and let packages from everywhere meet, re-sort overnight, and fly back out before dawn.
segments.tr: そして世界中からのパッケージを集め、一晩中再ソートし、夜明け前に飛び出します。

segments.src: From there your box moves to a local delivery station, gets loaded onto a van with 150 other stops, and a route algorithm decides the driver's sequence.
segments.tr: そこからあなたのボックスは地元の配送ステーションに移動し、150の他の配送先を持つバンに積まれ、ルートアルゴリズムがドライバーのシーケンスを決定します。

segments.src: That final leg — the delivery station to your door — is called the **last mile**, and it's routinely the single most expensive segment of the whole journey.
segments.tr: その最終区間（配送ステーションからあなたのドアまで）は**ラストマイル**と呼ばれ、通常、全体の移動の中で最も高価な単一区間です。

segments.src: One truck crossing Nebraska carries thousands of packages at once; one van in a Denver neighborhood carries a few hundred and burns an hour in traffic.
segments.tr: ネブラスカ州を横切る1台のトラックは一度に数千個のパッケージを運び、デンバーの近隣の1台のバンは数百個を運び、交通で1時間を消費します。

segments.src: Trucking is the largest single line item in U.S.
segments.tr: トラック輸送は米国で最大の単一ラインアイテムです。

segments.src: logistics spending, and last-mile delivery is why.
segments.tr: ロジスティクス支出において、ラストマイル配送がその理由です。

segments.src: "Free shipping" is, of course, not free.
segments.tr: もちろん、「送料無料」は無料ではありません。

segments.src: It's priced into the $89, subsidized by your membership fee, or absorbed as a customer-acquisition cost.
segments.tr: それは89ドルに値付けされ、会員費で補助されるか、顧客獲得費用として吸収されます。

segments.src: Somebody paid for the van.
segments.tr: 誰かがバンの費用を払いました。

segments.tr: ここでズームアウトします。

segments.src: Recent CSCMP *State of Logistics* reports put total U.S.
segments.tr: 最近のCSCMP *State of Logistics* レポートは、米国の総計を示しています。

segments.src: business logistics costs at roughly **$2.5 trillion, or about 8–9% of GDP**.
segments.tr: ビジネスロジスティクス費用は大約**2.5兆ドル、またはGDPの約8～9％**です。

segments.src: That's the scale of the industry that made your Tuesday delivery unremarkable.
segments.tr: それはあなたの火曜日の配送を普通にした産業の規模です。

segments.src: And it's changing fast.
segments.tr: そして急速に変わっています。

segments.src: Four trends worth knowing:
segments.tr: 知る価値のある4つのトレンド：

segments.src: 1. **E-commerce reshaped the network.** Retail logistics used to mean moving pallets to a few hundred stores. Now it means moving single boxes to millions of homes — a completely different cost structure, which is why warehouse space near cities got so valuable.
segments.tr: 1. **電子商取引がネットワークを再構築しました。** 小売ロジスティクスは以前、パレットを数百の店舗に移動させることを意味していました。現在、それは単一のボックスを数百万の家庭に移動させることを意味しています。完全に異なるコスト構造です。これが都市付近の倉庫スペースがとても価値があるようになった理由です。

segments.src: 2. **Automation is filling warehouses**, driven by both labor shortages and volume — robotic picking, automated sortation, and warehouse management software.
segments.tr: 2. **オートメーションが倉庫を満たしています**。労力不足と量の両方によって駆動されています。ロボット選別、自動ソーティング、倉庫管理ソフトウェアです。

segments.src: 3. **Resilience is now a board-level word.** The 2020–2022 disruptions — port congestion, the Suez blockage, chip shortages — taught companies that the cheapest supply chain and the most reliable one are rarely the same. Hence "nearshoring," dual sourcing, and holding a bit more safety stock than pure efficiency would suggest.
segments.tr: 3. **レジリエンスは現在ボードレベルの言葉です。** 2020～2022年の混乱（港湾混雑、スエズ運河の閉鎖、チップ不足）は、企業に最も安いサプライチェーンと最も信頼性の高いものが同じではないことを教えました。したがって、「ニアショアリング」、デュアルソーシング、および純粋な効率が示唆するよりも少し多くの安全在庫を保有することができます。

segments.src: 4. **Visibility is the new battleground.** Knowing exactly where a shipment is, and predicting when it will actually arrive, is often worth more than shaving a few cents off the freight rate.
segments.tr: 4. **可視性は新しい戦場です。** 正確に荷物がどこにあるかを知り、実際に到着するときを予測することは、しばしば運送料金を数セント節約するよりも価値があります。

segments.src: A last practical concept: when comparing two suppliers, the sticker price is the wrong number.
segments.tr: 最後の実践的な概念：2つのサプライヤーを比較する場合、定価は間違った数字です。

segments.src: What matters is **landed cost**:
segments.tr: 重要なのは**着地コスト**です：

segments.src: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling
segments.tr: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling

segments.src: A part that's 15% cheaper from overseas can easily be more expensive once it lands.
segments.tr: 海外から15％安い部品は、到着すると簡単にもっと高くなる可能性があります。

segments.src: That single line is why logistics belongs in strategy meetings and not just in the loading dock.
segments.tr: この単一の行が、ロジスティクスが戦略会議に属する理由であり、単に積み込みドックにだけではない理由です。

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3行のまとめ

segments.src: 1. Logistics is the move-store-handle-inform work that creates **place and time utility** — it doesn't change the product, it changes where and when it's available.
segments.tr: 1. ロジスティクスは、**場所と時間効用**を生み出す移動・保管・取扱・情報提供の仕事です。製品を変えるのではなく、どことその入手可能時期を変えます。

segments.src: 2. Logistics is a **subset of supply chain management**: SCM decides who makes what, where, and how much; logistics executes the physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: 2. ロジスティクスは**サプライチェーン管理のサブセット**です：SCMは誰が何を、どこで、どのくらいの量を作るかを決定します。ロジスティクスは物理的な流れと保管を実行します。

segments.src: 3. Every logistics decision is a **trade-off** among cost, speed, and reliability — and the honest number to compare is landed cost, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 3. すべてのロジスティクス決定は、コスト、速度、信頼性の間の**トレードオフ**です。比較する正直な数字は、定価ではなく着地コストです。

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日の用語

segments.src: - **Logistics** — Planning and controlling the efficient flow and storage of goods, services, and related information from origin to consumption, including returns.
segments.tr: - **ロジスティクス** — 原点から消費地点までの商品、サービス、関連情報の効率的な流れと保管の計画と管理。返品を含みます。

segments.src: - **Supply Chain Management (SCM)** — The broader coordination of sourcing, production, planning, and distribution across all partners from raw material to end customer; logistics sits inside it.
segments.tr: - **サプライチェーン管理（SCM）** — 原材料から最終顧客までのすべてのパートナー間での調達、生産、計画、配布のより広い調整。ロジスティクスはその内部に位置します。

segments.src: - **Last mile** — The final delivery leg from a local facility to the customer's door; typically the most expensive segment per package.
segments.tr: - **ラストマイル** — 地元の施設から顧客のドアへの最終配送区間。1パッケージあたり通常最も高価な区間です。

segments.src: - **Lead time** — Total elapsed time from placing an order to receiving it; the number customers actually feel.
segments.tr: - **リードタイム** — 注文を置くことから受け取ることまでの経過時間の合計。顧客が実際に感じる数字です。

segments.src: - **Landed cost** — The all-in cost of getting a purchased item to your door: unit price plus freight, duties, insurance, and handling.
segments.tr: - **着地コスト** — 購入品をあなたのドアに届ける全コスト：単価に運送料、関税、保険、取扱を加えたもの。

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics)** — An outside company hired to run warehousing, transportation, or fulfillment on your behalf instead of doing it in-house.
segments.tr: - **3PL（サードパーティロジスティクス）** — 社内で行う代わりに、あなたに代わって倉庫保管、輸送、またはフルフィルメントを実行するために雇われた外部企業。

segments.src: Logistics is the physical-flow-and-storage piece nested inside the wider SCM function, which also covers sourcing, demand planning, and supplier strategy.
segments.tr: ロジスティクスは、調達、需要計画、サプライヤー戦略もカバーする、より広いSCM機能内に入れ子にされた物理的な流れと保管のピースです。

segments.src: Long-haul legs spread their cost across thousands of packages; a delivery van covers far fewer stops per hour, so the last mile carries a disproportionate share of total delivery cost.

de.title: [Logistik 101 #1] Der Billionen-Dollar-Job, den niemand sieht: Was Logistik wirklich ist

segments.src: > Logistics is the work of getting the right thing to the right place at the right time and cost — and in the U.S. it's roughly a $2.5 trillion-a-year industry that most people only notice when it fails.
segments.tr: > Logistik ist die Aufgabe, die richtige Sache am richtigen Ort zur richtigen Zeit und zu den richtigen Kosten bereitzustellen – und in den USA ist sie eine Industrie von etwa 2,5 Billionen Dollar pro Jahr, die die meisten Menschen nur bemerken, wenn sie ausfällt.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Heutiges Konzept

segments.src: Ask someone what logistics is and you'll usually hear "trucks."
segments.tr: Fragen Sie jemanden, was Logistik ist, und Sie werden normalerweise "Lastwagen" hören.

segments.src: That's like saying finance is "ATMs."
segments.tr: Das ist, als würde man sagen, Finanzen sind "Geldautomaten".

segments.src: The trade association CSCMP defines logistics management as the part of supply chain management that plans, implements, and controls the efficient flow and storage of goods, services, and related information — from the point of origin to the point of consumption, and back again.
segments.tr: Der Wirtschaftsverband CSCMP definiert Logistikmanagement als den Teil des Supply-Chain-Managements, der den effizienten Fluss und die Lagerung von Waren, Dienstleistungen und zugehörigen Informationen plant, umsetzt und kontrolliert – vom Punkt der Herkunft bis zum Punkt des Verbrauchs und zurück.

segments.src: Strip out the jargon and you get four verbs: **move, store, handle, inform.**
segments.tr: Wenn man das Fachjargon entfernt, erhält man vier Verben: **befördern, lagern, handhaben, informieren.**

segments.src: Practitioners often summarize the goal as the **seven rights**: the right product, in the right quantity, in the right condition, at the right place, at the right time, to the right customer, at the right cost.
segments.tr: Praktiker fassen das Ziel oft als die **sieben Rechte** zusammen: das richtige Produkt, in der richtigen Menge, im richtigen Zustand, am richtigen Ort, zur richtigen Zeit, für den richtigen Kunden, zu den richtigen Kosten.

segments.src: Notice that six of the seven are about *service* and only one is about *price*.
segments.tr: Beachten Sie, dass sechs der sieben um *Dienstleistung* und nur einer um *Preis* geht.

segments.src: That tension is the entire discipline.
segments.tr: Diese Spannung ist die gesamte Disziplin.

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: logistics doesn't change what a product *is*.
segments.tr: Hier kommt der Teil, der die Menschen überrascht: Logistik ändert nicht, was ein Produkt *ist*.

segments.src: A pair of running shoes sitting in a warehouse in Ohio is chemically identical to the same pair on your doorstep in Denver.
segments.tr: Ein Paar Laufschuhe, das in einem Lagerhaus in Ohio sitzt, ist chemisch identisch mit dem gleichen Paar vor Ihrer Haustür in Denver.

segments.src: What logistics creates is **place utility** (value from being where you need it) and **time utility** (value from being there when you need it).
segments.tr: Was Logistik schafft, ist **Ortsnutzen** (Wert davon, wo Sie es brauchen) und **Zeitnutzen** (Wert davon, es zu bekommen, wenn Sie es brauchen).

segments.src: An umbrella in a warehouse is inventory.
segments.tr: Ein Regenschirm in einem Lagerhaus ist Bestand.

segments.src: An umbrella in a store lobby during a downpour is a sale.
segments.tr: Ein Regenschirm in der Lobby eines Geschäfts während eines Platzregens ist ein Verkauf.

segments.src: **So how is this different from supply chain management?** Think of nested boxes.
segments.tr: **Also, wie unterscheidet sich das vom Supply-Chain-Management?** Denken Sie an verschachtelte Kisten.

segments.src: Supply chain management (SCM) is the bigger box — it covers sourcing raw materials, negotiating with suppliers, planning production, forecasting demand, and coordinating everyone from the cotton farmer to the cashier.
segments.tr: Supply-Chain-Management (SCM) ist die größere Kiste – es deckt die Beschaffung von Rohstoffen, Verhandlungen mit Lieferanten, Produktionsplanung, Nachfrageprognosen und die Koordination aller von der Baumwollbauerin bis zur Kassiererin ab.

segments.src: Logistics is the box inside it that handles physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: Logistik ist die Kiste darin, die den physischen Fluss und die Lagerung handhabt.

segments.src: A useful shorthand:
segments.tr: Eine nützliche Kurzform:

segments.src: - **SCM asks:** who should make this, where, in what quantity, and on what terms?
segments.tr: - **SCM fragt:** Wer sollte dies machen, wo, in welcher Menge und zu welchen Bedingungen?

segments.src: - **Logistics asks:** given those decisions, how does it physically get there, how fast, and at what cost?
segments.tr: - **Logistik fragt:** Wie kommt es physisch dorthin, angesichts dieser Entscheidungen, wie schnell und zu welchen Kosten?

segments.src: You can't do good SCM without logistics, but logistics alone won't save you from a bad sourcing decision.
segments.tr: Sie können kein gutes SCM ohne Logistik machen, aber Logistik allein wird Sie nicht vor einer schlechten Beschaffungsentscheidung bewahren.

segments.src: If your supplier is 8,000 miles away and your product has a six-week shelf life, no amount of clever routing fixes that.
segments.tr: Wenn Ihr Lieferant 8.000 Meilen entfernt ist und Ihr Produkt eine Haltbarkeit von sechs Wochen hat, wird auch noch so geschicktes Routing das nicht beheben.

segments.src: The other thing to know upfront: logistics is a **trade-off machine**, not an optimization with one answer.
segments.tr: Das andere, das Sie wissen sollten: Logistik ist eine **Abwägungs-Maschine**, keine Optimierung mit einer Antwort.

segments.src: Air freight is fast and expensive; ocean is cheap and slow.
segments.tr: Luftfracht ist schnell und teuer; Schiff ist billig und langsam.

segments.src: Holding lots of inventory means you never stock out, but the industry rule of thumb is that carrying inventory costs roughly 20–25% of its value per year in capital, warehousing, insurance, and obsolescence.
segments.tr: Das Halten vieler Bestände bedeutet, dass Sie nie ausverkauft sind, aber die branchentypische Faustregel besagt, dass die Lagerung von Bestand ungefähr 20–25% seines Wertes pro Jahr an Kapital, Lagerhaltung, Versicherung und Obsoleszenz kostet.

segments.src: Five regional warehouses shorten delivery times but multiply fixed costs.
segments.tr: Fünf regionale Lagerhäuser verkürzen die Lieferzeiten, vervielfachen aber die Fixkosten.

segments.src: Every logistics decision is somebody choosing a point on a curve — usually the curve between **cost and speed**, or between **cost and reliability**.
segments.tr: Jede Logistikentscheidung ist jemand, der einen Punkt auf einer Kurve wählt – normalerweise die Kurve zwischen **Kosten und Geschwindigkeit** oder zwischen **Kosten und Zuverlässigkeit**.

segments.src: Four trends worth knowing:
segments.tr: Vier Trends, die es wert sind, zu kennen:

segments.src: 1. **E-commerce reshaped the network.** Retail logistics used to mean moving pallets to a few hundred stores. Now it means moving single boxes to millions of homes — a completely different cost structure, which is why warehouse space near cities got so valuable.
segments.tr: 1. **E-Commerce hat das Netzwerk umgestaltet.** Einzelhandelslogistik bedeutete früher, Paletten zu einigen hundert Geschäften zu bewegen. Jetzt bedeutet es, einzelne Schachteln zu Millionen von Häusern zu bewegen – eine völlig andere Kostenstruktur, weshalb Lagerfläche in der Nähe von Städten so wertvoll wurde.

segments.src: 2. **Automation is filling warehouses**, driven by both labor shortages and volume — robotic picking, automated sortation, and warehouse management software.
segments.tr: 2. **Automatisierung füllt Lagerhäuser**, getrieben durch Arbeitskräftemangel und Volumen – automatisiertes Kommissionieren, automatisierte Sortation und Lagerverwaltungssoftware.

segments.src: 3. **Resilience is now a board-level word.** The 2020–2022 disruptions — port congestion, the Suez blockage, chip shortages — taught companies that the cheapest supply chain and the most reliable one are rarely the same. Hence "nearshoring," dual sourcing, and holding a bit more safety stock than pure efficiency would suggest.
segments.tr: 3. **Widerstandsfähigkeit ist jetzt ein Wort auf Vorstandsebene.** Die Störungen 2020–2022 – Hafenstaus, die Blockade des Suez-Kanals, Chipengpässe – lehrten Unternehmen, dass die billigste Lieferkette und die zuverlässigste selten gleich sind. Daher "Nearshoring", Mehrfachbeschaffung und das Halten von ein wenig mehr Sicherheitsbestand als die reine Effizienz nahelegen würde.

segments.src: 4. **Visibility is the new battleground.** Knowing exactly where a shipment is, and predicting when it will actually arrive, is often worth more than shaving a few cents off the freight rate.
segments.tr: 4. **Transparenz ist das neue Schlachtfeld.** Zu wissen, wo sich eine Sendung genau befindet, und vorherzusagen, wann sie tatsächlich ankommt, ist oft mehr wert als ein paar Cent von der Frachtrate zu sparen.

segments.src: A last practical concept: when comparing two suppliers, the sticker price is the wrong number.
segments.tr: Ein letztes praktisches Konzept: Wenn Sie zwei Lieferanten vergleichen, ist der Aufkleberpreis die falsche Zahl.

segments.src: What matters is **landed cost**:
segments.tr: Was zählt, ist **Gesamteinstandspreis**:

segments.src: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling
segments.tr: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling

segments.src: A part that's 15% cheaper from overseas can easily be more expensive once it lands.
segments.tr: Ein Teil, das aus dem Ausland 15% billiger ist, kann leicht teurer sein, sobald es ankommt.

segments.src: That single line is why logistics belongs in strategy meetings and not just in the loading dock.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3-Zeilen-Zusammenfassung

segments.src: 1. Logistics is the move-store-handle-inform work that creates **place and time utility** — it doesn't change the product, it changes where and when it's available.
segments.tr: 1. Logistik ist die Beförderungs-, Lagerungs-, Handhabungs- und Informationsarbeit, die **Orts- und Zeitnutzen** schafft – sie ändert nicht das Produkt, sie ändert, wo und wann es verfügbar ist.

segments.src: 2. Logistics is a **subset of supply chain management**: SCM decides who makes what, where, and how much; logistics executes the physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: 2. Logistik ist eine **Teilmenge des Supply-Chain-Managements**: SCM entscheidet, wer was, wo und wie viel macht; Logistik führt den physischen Fluss und die Lagerung aus.

segments.src: 3. Every logistics decision is a **trade-off** among cost, speed, and reliability — and the honest number to compare is landed cost, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 3. Jede Logistikentscheidung ist eine **Abwägung** zwischen Kosten, Geschwindigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit – und die ehrliche Zahl zum Vergleichen ist der Gesamteinstandspreis, nicht der Aufkleberpreis.

segments.tr: ## 📚 Heutige Terminologie

segments.src: - **Logistics** — Planning and controlling the efficient flow and storage of goods, services, and related information from origin to consumption, including returns.
segments.tr: - **Logistik** — Planung und Kontrolle des effizienten Flusses und der Lagerung von Waren, Dienstleistungen und zugehörigen Informationen von der Herkunft bis zum Verbrauch, einschließlich Rückgaben.

segments.src: - **Supply Chain Management (SCM)** — The broader coordination of sourcing, production, planning, and distribution across all partners from raw material to end customer; logistics sits inside it.
segments.tr: - **Supply-Chain-Management (SCM)** — Die breitere Koordination von Beschaffung, Produktion, Planung und Verteilung über alle Partner von Rohstoff bis Endkunde; Logistik sitzt darin.

segments.src: - **Last mile** — The final delivery leg from a local facility to the customer's door; typically the most expensive segment per package.
segments.tr: - **Letzte Meile** — Das letzte Lieferstück von einer lokalen Anlage zur Kundentür; typischerweise das teuerste Segment pro Paket.

segments.src: - **Lead time** — Total elapsed time from placing an order to receiving it; the number customers actually feel.
segments.tr: - **Vorlaufzeit** — Gesamtverstrichene Zeit vom Aufgeben einer Bestellung bis zum Erhalt; die Zahl, die Kunden tatsächlich spüren.

segments.src: - **Landed cost** — The all-in cost of getting a purchased item to your door: unit price plus freight, duties, insurance, and handling.
segments.tr: - **Gesamteinstandspreis** — Die Gesamtkosten, um einen gekauften Artikel zu Ihrer Tür zu bringen: Stückpreis plus Fracht, Zölle, Versicherung und Handling.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics)** — An outside company hired to run warehousing, transportation, or fulfillment on your behalf instead of doing it in-house.
segments.tr: - **3PL (Drittanbieter-Logistik)** — Ein externes Unternehmen, das eingestellt wurde, um Lagerhaltung, Transport oder Erfüllung in Ihrem Namen durchzuführen, anstatt es intern zu tun.

vi.title: [Logistics 101 #1] Công việc hàng tỉ đô la mà không ai nhìn thấy: Logistics thực sự là gì

segments.src: > Logistics is the work of getting the right thing to the right place at the right time and cost — and in the U.S. it's roughly a $2.5 trillion-a-year industry that most people only notice when it fails.
segments.tr: > Logistics là công việc đưa sản phẩm đúng đến đúng nơi vào đúng thời gian và chi phí — và ở Mỹ, đó là một ngành công nghiệp khoảng $2,5 nghìn tỷ mỗi năm mà hầu hết mọi người chỉ chú ý khi nó thất bại.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Khái niệm hôm nay

segments.src: Ask someone what logistics is and you'll usually hear "trucks."
segments.tr: Hỏi ai đó logistics là gì và bạn thường sẽ nghe "xe tải."

segments.src: That's like saying finance is "ATMs."
segments.tr: Đó giống như nói tài chính là "máy ATM".

segments.src: The trade association CSCMP defines logistics management as the part of supply chain management that plans, implements, and controls the efficient flow and storage of goods, services, and related information — from the point of origin to the point of consumption, and back again.
segments.tr: Hiệp hội thương mại CSCMP định nghĩa quản lý logistics là phần của quản lý chuỗi cung ứng lên kế hoạch, triển khai và kiểm soát dòng chảy hiệu quả và lưu trữ hàng hóa, dịch vụ và thông tin liên quan — từ điểm nguồn gốc đến điểm tiêu thụ, và trở lại.

segments.src: Strip out the jargon and you get four verbs: **move, store, handle, inform.**
segments.tr: Loại bỏ thuật ngữ chuyên môn và bạn sẽ có bốn động từ: **di chuyển, lưu trữ, xử lý, thông báo**.

segments.src: Practitioners often summarize the goal as the **seven rights**: the right product, in the right quantity, in the right condition, at the right place, at the right time, to the right customer, at the right cost.
segments.tr: Các chuyên gia thường tóm tắt mục tiêu là **bảy điều đúng**: sản phẩm đúng, số lượng đúng, tình trạng đúng, nơi đúng, thời gian đúng, khách hàng đúng, chi phí đúng.

segments.src: Notice that six of the seven are about *service* and only one is about *price*.
segments.tr: Lưu ý rằng sáu trong bảy cái là về *dịch vụ* và chỉ một cái là về *giá*.

segments.src: That tension is the entire discipline.
segments.tr: Căng thẳng đó là toàn bộ ngành học.

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: logistics doesn't change what a product *is*.
segments.tr: Đây là phần làm ngạc nhiên mọi người: logistics không thay đổi sản phẩm là *cái gì*.

segments.src: A pair of running shoes sitting in a warehouse in Ohio is chemically identical to the same pair on your doorstep in Denver.
segments.tr: Một đôi giày chạy đặt trong một kho ở Ohio giống hệt nhau về hóa học với cùng một đôi trên ngưỡng cửa của bạn ở Denver.

segments.src: What logistics creates is **place utility** (value from being where you need it) and **time utility** (value from being there when you need it).
segments.tr: Những gì logistics tạo ra là **tiện ích địa điểm** (giá trị từ việc ở nơi bạn cần) và **tiện ích thời gian** (giá trị từ việc ở đó khi bạn cần).

segments.src: An umbrella in a warehouse is inventory.
segments.tr: Một chiếc ô trong một kho là tồn kho.

segments.src: An umbrella in a store lobby during a downpour is a sale.
segments.tr: Một chiếc ô trong sảnh cửa hàng trong trận mưa như trút nước là một bán hàng.

segments.src: **So how is this different from supply chain management?** Think of nested boxes.
segments.tr: **Vậy điều này khác với quản lý chuỗi cung ứng như thế nào?** Hãy nghĩ về các hộp lồng nhau.

segments.src: Supply chain management (SCM) is the bigger box — it covers sourcing raw materials, negotiating with suppliers, planning production, forecasting demand, and coordinating everyone from the cotton farmer to the cashier.
segments.tr: Quản lý chuỗi cung ứng (SCM) là hộp lớn hơn — nó bao gồm tìm nguyên liệu thô, đàm phán với nhà cung cấp, lên kế hoạch sản xuất, dự báo nhu cầu, và phối hợp mọi người từ nông dân bông đến nhân viên bán hàng.

segments.src: Logistics is the box inside it that handles physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: Logistics là hộp bên trong nó xử lý dòng chảy vật lý và lưu trữ.

segments.src: A useful shorthand:
segments.tr: Một cách viết tắt hữu ích:

segments.src: - **SCM asks:** who should make this, where, in what quantity, and on what terms?
segments.tr: - **SCM hỏi:** ai nên làm cái này, ở đâu, với số lượng bao nhiêu, và trên những điều khoản nào?

segments.src: - **Logistics asks:** given those decisions, how does it physically get there, how fast, and at what cost?
segments.tr: - **Logistics hỏi:** cho những quyết định đó, nó vật lý đến đó như thế nào, nhanh như thế nào, và với chi phí bao nhiêu?

segments.src: You can't do good SCM without logistics, but logistics alone won't save you from a bad sourcing decision.
segments.tr: Bạn không thể thực hiện SCM tốt mà không có logistics, nhưng logistics một mình sẽ không cứu bạn khỏi quyết định tìm nguồn cấp kém.

segments.src: If your supplier is 8,000 miles away and your product has a six-week shelf life, no amount of clever routing fixes that.
segments.tr: Nếu nhà cung cấp của bạn cách xa 8.000 dặm và sản phẩm của bạn có thời hạn bảo quản sáu tuần, không có bất kỳ lượng định tuyến thông minh nào khác phục cái đó.

segments.src: The other thing to know upfront: logistics is a **trade-off machine**, not an optimization with one answer.
segments.tr: Điều khác để biết trước: logistics là một **máy đánh đổi**, không phải là tối ưu hóa với một câu trả lời.

segments.src: Air freight is fast and expensive; ocean is cheap and slow.
segments.tr: Vận chuyển hàng không nhanh và đắt; vận chuyển biển rẻ và chậm.

segments.src: Holding lots of inventory means you never stock out, but the industry rule of thumb is that carrying inventory costs roughly 20–25% of its value per year in capital, warehousing, insurance, and obsolescence.
segments.tr: Giữ rất nhiều tồn kho có nghĩa là bạn không bao giờ hết hàng, nhưng quy tắc ngón tay của ngành là chi phí mang theo tồn kho khoảng 20–25% giá trị của nó mỗi năm trong vốn, lưu trữ, bảo hiểm, và tính lỗi thời.

segments.src: Five regional warehouses shorten delivery times but multiply fixed costs.
segments.tr: Năm kho quốc phòng rút ngắn thời gian giao hàng nhưng nhân lên chi phí cố định.

segments.src: Every logistics decision is somebody choosing a point on a curve — usually the curve between **cost and speed**, or between **cost and reliability**.
segments.tr: Mọi quyết định logistics là ai đó chọn một điểm trên một đường cong — thường là đường cong giữa **chi phí và tốc độ**, hoặc giữa **chi phí và độ tin cậy**.

segments.src: And it's changing fast.
segments.tr: Và nó đang thay đổi nhanh chóng.

segments.src: Four trends worth knowing:
segments.tr: Bốn xu hướng đáng để biết:

segments.src: 1. **E-commerce reshaped the network.** Retail logistics used to mean moving pallets to a few hundred stores. Now it means moving single boxes to millions of homes — a completely different cost structure, which is why warehouse space near cities got so valuable.
segments.tr: 1. **Thương mại điện tử định hình lại mạng.** Logistics bán lẻ từng có nghĩa là di chuyển pallet đến một vài trăm cửa hàng. Bây giờ nó có nghĩa là di chuyển các hộp đơn lẻ đến hàng triệu ngôi nhà — một cơ cấu chi phí hoàn toàn khác, đó là lý do tại sao không gian kho gần thành phố trở nên quý giá.

segments.src: 2. **Automation is filling warehouses**, driven by both labor shortages and volume — robotic picking, automated sortation, and warehouse management software.
segments.tr: 2. **Tự động hóa đang lấp đầy các kho**, được thúc đẩy bởi cả thiếu hụt lao động và khối lượng — nhặt hàng bằng robot, phân loại tự động, và phần mềm quản lý kho.

segments.src: 3. **Resilience is now a board-level word.** The 2020–2022 disruptions — port congestion, the Suez blockage, chip shortages — taught companies that the cheapest supply chain and the most reliable one are rarely the same. Hence "nearshoring," dual sourcing, and holding a bit more safety stock than pure efficiency would suggest.
segments.tr: 3. **Khả năng phục hồi là một từ ở cấp độ hội đồng quản trị.** Các gián đoạn 2020–2022 — tắc nghẽn cảng, chặn kênh Suez, thiếu hụt chip — đã dạy cho các công ty rằng chuỗi cung ứng rẻ nhất và chuỗi đáng tin cậy nhất hiếm khi giống nhau. Do đó "nearshoring," tìm nguồn cấp kép, và giữ một chút tồn kho an toàn hơn những gì hiệu quả thuần túy sẽ gợi ý.

segments.src: 4. **Visibility is the new battleground.** Knowing exactly where a shipment is, and predicting when it will actually arrive, is often worth more than shaving a few cents off the freight rate.
segments.tr: 4. **Khả năng hiển thị là chiến trường mới.** Biết chính xác một lô hàng ở đâu, và dự đoán khi nó thực sự sẽ đến, thường đáng giá hơn giảm bớt một vài xu từ tỷ lệ vận chuyển.

segments.src: A last practical concept: when comparing two suppliers, the sticker price is the wrong number.
segments.tr: Một khái niệm thực tế cuối cùng: khi so sánh hai nhà cung cấp, giá niêm yết là con số sai.

segments.src: What matters is **landed cost**:
segments.tr: Điều quan trọng là **chi phí hạ cánh**:

segments.src: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling
segments.tr: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling

segments.src: A part that's 15% cheaper from overseas can easily be more expensive once it lands.
segments.tr: Một bộ phận rẻ hơn 15% từ nước ngoài có thể dễ dàng trở nên đắt hơn khi nó hạ cánh.

segments.src: That single line is why logistics belongs in strategy meetings and not just in the loading dock.
segments.tr: Dòng đơn lẻ đó là lý do tại sao logistics thuộc về các cuộc họp chiến lược và không chỉ ở bãi đỗ tải.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Tóm tắt 3 dòng

segments.src: 1. Logistics is the move-store-handle-inform work that creates **place and time utility** — it doesn't change the product, it changes where and when it's available.
segments.tr: 1. Logistics là công việc di chuyển-lưu trữ-xử lý-thông báo tạo ra **tiện ích địa điểm và thời gian** — nó không thay đổi sản phẩm, nó thay đổi nơi và khi nó có sẵn.

segments.src: 2. Logistics is a **subset of supply chain management**: SCM decides who makes what, where, and how much; logistics executes the physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: 2. Logistics là một **tập con của quản lý chuỗi cung ứng**: SCM quyết định ai làm cái gì, ở đâu, và bao nhiêu; logistics thực hiện dòng chảy vật lý và lưu trữ.

segments.src: 3. Every logistics decision is a **trade-off** among cost, speed, and reliability — and the honest number to compare is landed cost, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 3. Mọi quyết định logistics là một **sự đánh đổi** giữa chi phí, tốc độ, và độ tin cậy — và con số trung thực để so sánh là chi phí hạ cánh, không phải giá niêm yết.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Thuật ngữ hôm nay

segments.src: - **Logistics** — Planning and controlling the efficient flow and storage of goods, services, and related information from origin to consumption, including returns.
segments.tr: - **Logistics** — Lập kế hoạch và kiểm soát dòng chảy hiệu quả và lưu trữ hàng hóa, dịch vụ, và thông tin liên quan từ nguồn gốc đến tiêu thụ, bao gồm cả vé trả lại.

segments.src: - **Supply Chain Management (SCM)** — The broader coordination of sourcing, production, planning, and distribution across all partners from raw material to end customer; logistics sits inside it.
segments.tr: - **Supply Chain Management (SCM)** — Sự phối hợp rộng hơn về tìm nguồn cấp, sản xuất, lập kế hoạch, và phân phối trên tất cả các đối tác từ nguyên liệu thô đến khách hàng cuối cùng; logistics nằm bên trong nó.

segments.src: - **Last mile** — The final delivery leg from a local facility to the customer's door; typically the most expensive segment per package.
segments.tr: - **Last mile** — Chặng giao hàng cuối cùng từ một cơ sở địa phương đến cửa của khách hàng; thường là phần đắt nhất trên mỗi gói.

segments.src: - **Lead time** — Total elapsed time from placing an order to receiving it; the number customers actually feel.
segments.tr: - **Lead time** — Tổng thời gian trôi qua từ khi đặt hàng đến khi nhận được; con số mà khách hàng thực sự cảm thấy.

segments.src: - **Landed cost** — The all-in cost of getting a purchased item to your door: unit price plus freight, duties, insurance, and handling.
segments.tr: - **Landed cost** — Chi phí toàn bộ để đưa một mặt hàng mua được đến cửa của bạn: giá đơn vị cộng với vận chuyển, thuế, bảo hiểm, và xử lý.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics)** — An outside company hired to run warehousing, transportation, or fulfillment on your behalf instead of doing it in-house.
segments.tr: - **3PL (third-party logistics)** — Một công ty bên ngoài được thuê để chạy lưu trữ, vận chuyển, hoặc thực hiện đơn hàng thay mặt bạn thay vì làm việc trong nhà.
*Đáp án: 1 → (B).

segments.src: Logistics is the physical-flow-and-storage piece nested inside the wider SCM function, which also covers sourcing, demand planning, and supplier strategy.
segments.tr: Logistics là phần dòng chảy vật lý và lưu trữ lồng nhau bên trong chức năng SCM rộng hơn, cũng bao gồm tìm nguồn cấp, lập kế hoạch nhu cầu, và chiến lược nhà cung cấp.

segments.src: Long-haul legs spread their cost across thousands of packages; a delivery van covers far fewer stops per hour, so the last mile carries a disproportionate share of total delivery cost.
segments.tr: Các chặng vận chuyển dài lan tỏa chi phí của chúng trên hàng ngàn gói; một chiếc xe van giao hàng bao phủ ít dừng hơn nhiều mỗi giờ, vì vậy dặm cuối cùng mang một phần không cân xứng của tổng chi phí giao hàng.
